messages:
chris: heads up — compliance just flagged multiple permission-change events with missing actor metadata after last night's rbac-refactor deploy. example: `actor: null` for a grant to service-account-analytics. can anyone who ran migrations last night confirm?

maria: saw the same in the weekly compliance scan. the report points to grants between 02:10-02:25 UTC. query I ran: `select * from audit.events where resource='roles' and verb='grant' and actor is null limit 50` — lots of hits.

alex: that time window lines up with my perm-reconciler run. i kicked off a one-off migration to normalize role names across orgs. i used the infra service principal to run it (infra-sa@redwood). i thought the reconciler sets `actor` to the caller, but maybe the migration path bypassed the normal emitter.

dina: can you paste a sample event?

chris: paste from ES (redacted):
```
{"ts": "2026-03-18T02:14:07Z", "type": "permission_change", "resource": "roles/service-analytics", "action": "grant", "target": "service-account-analytics", "actor": null, "metadata": {"trigger":"rbac-migration-v2","job_id":"mig-20260318-7"}}
```

alex: ah ok — reconciler ran in `batch` mode which calls the emitter library with `system_context=true` for bulk ops. emitter currently sets `actor` only when `context.user` is present; system_context clears that. i can see how that becomes null.

maria: compliance needs a clear who/what for attestation. if we can't backfill reliably we may need to flag impacted customers. what's the scope?

chris: rough counts: ~120 grant events with null actor, plus ~30 role deletes. all in the same job id. looks confined to `orgs/*/analytics` and the `service-account-analytics` principal.

sec-bot: automated note — opened SEC-4578: "Audit events missing actor for batch rbac migration" and assigned to @alex. severity=high.

alex: i'll take SEC-4578. immediate plan: 1) add a quick patch to emitter to populate `actor` with `origin_service` when `user` is missing (so we don't lose provenance), 2) run a targeted re-emission for the job_id to generate corrected audit events (emit as correlated events referencing original ts), 3) add a reconciler check to fail if actor would be null in future runs.

maria: good. for compliance, we also need an export of the original null-actor events plus the re-emitted corrected versions so auditors can see chain of custody. can you include a mapping file?

alex: yes — i'll produce a CSV with `original_event_id, original_ts, new_event_id, new_ts, actor` and push to `s3://redwood-compliance/attestations/SEC-4578/`.

chris: any KMS implications? we rotate keys nightly — if the migration used a rotated key maybe the emitter failed to sign metadata.

dina: looked at KMS logs — no failed sign calls during that window. infra-sa used the same key. KMS returned OK/200. not seeing key errors.

maria: what's ETA for patch + re-emit? compliance wants to close the gap before EOD tomorrow.

alex: i'll push a hotfix branch in next 90m and request a quick canary. re-emit will need a controlled producer job — estimate 3-4 hours to run safely with throttling. so end-of-day tomorrow is tight but doable.

chris: please add a regression test to the reconciler pipeline: run in dry-run mode and assert `actor != null` for all outbound events. also add an alert if >0 events emitted with null actor.

alex: yep — adding unit + integration. also adding a log line in emitter when `actor` is inferred: `actor_inferred: origin_service=<svc>` so it's auditable.

sec-bot: automated note — jira SEC-4578 updated: assignee=alex, priority=P1, due=2026-03-19T23:59:00Z.

compliance-bot: automated scan result — impacted_count=150, impacted_customers=[org-231, org-678, org-999]. please confirm remediation plan for external reporting.

maria: we will need a short external-facing blurb if customers ask. i'll draft one after we confirm backfill.

alex: status update: hotfix branch pushed `rbac-emitter-actor-fallback`, running canary now in staging. if green, will deploy to prod in the maintenance window and start re-emit job with `throttle=50/s`.

chris: thanks. once re-emit completes, run the compliance export and tag emails to the compliance mailbox. also add a postmortem note in `sources/slack/postmortems` and link the jira.

maria: noted — i'll prepare the attestation template and incident blurb.

alex: can folks ack the plan? @dina @chris @maria

dina: ack, will monitor KMS and signer metrics.

chris: ack. i'll coordinate with oncall for the deploy window and watch audit-sink throughput.

maria: ack. compliance will hold off external notifications until we have the backfill CSV.

sec-bot: automated note — thread SEC-4578 status changed to "in progress".
